name: Yard mechanism anti-condensation interface
summary: Shows the selected mechanism enclosure's conditioning-heater and control connection.
description: Shows the selected mechanism enclosure's conditioning-heater and control connection. Yard equipment supervision carries the condition and support-system information of primary equipment into station alarms. A monitor's declared alarm, measurement and self-fault output need separate point names.

In a switchyard marshalling kiosk, gas compartment, operating mechanism and cabinet-service indications are collected for the station controller. Their equipment tags identify the actual compartment or mechanism being monitored. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Mechanism heater supply and control” at the input and “Conditioning heater operation” at the output. Heater power is separate from drive power.

Keep primary-device identity, compartment boundaries and monitor health visible. A monitoring illustration does not establish a leak rate, operating threshold or remaining equipment life. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
